title: OASIS UNCOVERS: HIGH-QUALITY T2I MODELS, SAME OLD STEREOTYPES
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying visual stereotypes in text-to-image models. While it identifies 'religious attire' and religious terms (e.g., Imam, Sheikh) as stereotypical attributes for certain nationalities, its primary objective is the benchmarking of sociological bias and stereotypes rather than the evaluation of religious knowledge, theology, or ethical/moral frameworks.
